scenarios.name: maintenance items, schedules and service logs are adults-only: a child can neither read nor write them

steps.sql: INSERT INTO app_home_maintenance__items (id, name, location, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
INSERT INTO app_home_maintenance__activities (id, item_id, name, interval_days, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 90, ?)
INSERT INTO app_home_maintenance__logs (id, activity_id, item_id, done_by, done_at, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
INSERT INTO app_home_maintenance__logs (id, activity_id, item_id, done_by, done_at, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
UPDATE app_home_maintenance__activities SET interval_days = 1 WHERE id = ?

SELECT i.name AS item, a.name AS activity, a.interval_days, l.id AS log_id FROM app_home_maintenance__logs l JOIN app_home_maintenance__activities a ON a.id = l.activity_id JOIN app_home_maintenance__items i ON i.id = l.item_id
